description: The object definition for a sync change set.

@context.description: The LD Context for the change set.

type.description: The LD Type for the change set.

id.description: The id of the change set.

storageKey.description: The storage key of the change set. This is used to identify the entities being synchronised.

dateCreated.description: The date the change set was created.

dateModified.description: The date the change set was last modified.

nodeIdentity.description: The identity of the node that created the change set.

changes.description: The changes to apply after a snapshot.
